summary_en: 568,700 shares (2.60% of S/O); ¥1.7B limit; ToSTNeT-3 block purchase on 2026-08-05 at prior day close (¥2,813/share); single trading session order.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 4 August 2026, Topy Industries' board resolved to acquire up to 568,700 treasury shares (2.60% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥1.7 billion. The acquisition is to be executed via a single ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block trade on 5 August 2026 at the prior day close of ¥2,813 per share, with results published immediately after the 08:45 JST trading session. The purchase order is valid only for that specific trading window. The company stated the acquisition supports flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 2,184,051 treasury shares out of 24,077,510 issued shares.
